title: Site Logistics And Material Handling
document_title: SSX Master Site Logistics and Material Handling Activities

items.text: What moves or changes? | People, vehicles, materials, equipment, waste, barriers, routes, cranes, hoists or storage
cells: People, vehicles, materials, equipment, waste, barriers, routes, cranes, hoists or storage

items.text: From and to where? | Gate, street, dock, laydown area, floor, room, roof, shaft, workface or offsite facility
cells: Gate, street, dock, laydown area, floor, room, roof, shaft, workface or offsite facility

items.text: When? | Delivery window, shift, phase, road closure, crane pick, relocation or removal date
cells: Delivery window, shift, phase, road closure, crane pick, relocation or removal date

items.text: Who controls it? | Logistics manager, superintendent, trade, carrier, operator, rigger, flagger, security or authority
cells: Logistics manager, superintendent, trade, carrier, operator, rigger, flagger, security or authority

items.text: How? | Truck, forklift, telehandler, crane, hoist, elevator, cart, conveyor, pump or manual handling
cells: Truck, forklift, telehandler, crane, hoist, elevator, cart, conveyor, pump or manual handling

items.text: What must be ready? | Permit, route, capacity, clearance, bearing, operator, rigging, protection, labor or receiver
cells: Permit, route, capacity, clearance, bearing, operator, rigging, protection, labor or receiver

items.text: What could conflict? | Public traffic, emergency access, workers, other deliveries, overhead work, utilities, weather or occupied operations
cells: Public traffic, emergency access, workers, other deliveries, overhead work, utilities, weather or occupied operations

items.text: What proves completion? | Approved plan, reservation, inspection, delivery ticket, lift record, photograph, restored area or release
cells: Approved plan, reservation, inspection, delivery ticket, lift record, photograph, restored area or release

items.text: Establish gates, routes, docks and staging
Verify route, load and unloading requirements
Inspect equipment and assign qualified personnel
Move material to storage or workface
Relocate logistics systems as construction advances
Material moves to storage or workface
Return or dispose of remaining material
Confirm weight and center of gravity
Identify operator, rigger and signal person
Monitor wind for crane and hoist use
Gate and route setup → mobilization and deliveries
Link logistics activities to the construction work they enable.
Calculate delivery dates from workface need dates and storage limits.
Assign exact gates, routes, time windows and receiving parties.
Verify route and equipment capacity before shipment.
Separate delivery, unloading, receiving, storage and movement to workface.
Schedule permits, closures, escorts and public notices.
Protect emergency access and required egress at all times.
Include crane and hoist erection, inspection, maintenance, relocation and removal.
Control double handling and excessive onsite inventory.
Update logistics plans as the project phases.
Coordinate public, occupied-facility and adjacent-property impacts.
Schedule removal and full restoration of temporary logistics systems.
